PlatformRunRequest.description:
What a person may supply. The provider, the model and the way data is read are not here:
they are set by a platform admin, so a caller cannot pick them.
PlatformRunRequest.title: PlatformRunRequest

schema.title: Response List Agents Admin Agents Get

post.description:
Try an agent on the built-in invented demo sites, before switching it on. Uses the agent's
current settings but the provider chosen here. Not stored with any customer's runs, because
it touches no customer's data.

delete.description:
Go back to the built-in spec. An agent with no stored status is a draft, so this switches
the agent off for customers.

put.description: Replace the agent's operating settings. The result is validated as a whole spec first.

post.description:
Create a customer organisation and its first administrator. The administrator signs in
and adds everyone else; the platform admin never gains access to the customer's data.

schema.title: Response Organisation Users Admin Organizations  Org Id  Users Get

get.description:
Counts and token totals per organisation, agent and day. Counts only: the content of any
run stays with the customer.

The agents a person can run: only those a platform admin has switched on. The supervisor
is used through the assistant, not listed here.

post.description:
Run one agent on one of the caller's sites. A run that fails its checks is still a 200
with status 'failed', and it is stored like any other.

Local development only: sign in as a seeded person by email, with no password. The route
answers 404 anywhere that has no development secret, which is everywhere but local.

schema.title: Response List Documents Knowledge Documents Get

post.description: Send plain text or markdown as the request body.

schema.title: Response Get Run Runs  Run Id  Get

post.description:
Send a CSV file (`timestamp,power_kw`) as the request body. The file is accepted whole or
refused whole. With `dry_run=true` it is checked and nothing is stored.

get.description: Hourly average demand for the last `days` days, for charts.

schema.title: Response Site Series Sites  Slug  Series Get

get.description: The computed figures for a site, the same ones the agents are given.

post.description: Draft a ticket for an event at one of the caller's sites. It waits for a manager.

get.description: How much this organisation's agents were used, from this organisation's own runs.

post.description:
Add someone to this organisation. They sign in with their own account; there is no
password here.
